bear_assumptions: Forward EPS normalizes near USD 2.50 at 36x as concentration or deployment delays surface and scale-up, service or policy costs constrain margins.
base_assumptions: Forward EPS reaches USD 4.50 at 40x as contracted AI deployments support growth while dilution, concentration and competition cap the multiple.
bull_assumptions: Forward EPS reaches USD 6.00 at 50x as Oracle deployment, broader hyperscaler adoption and capacity expansion deliver exceptional growth with controlled service and financing costs.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh operating evidence and a lower price make confidence-adjusted expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety and an accepted relationship clear canonical gates; downgrade further if deployments, customer diversification, margins, cash conversion, capacity, service costs, fuel or emissions economics deteriorate.
